description: Fork of exp670, replace qk/v/out_proj settings with exp611's (no S-split, single head per real head, larger tph). qk_lut: S=1 (n_heads=H=6), NAP=4, tph=256, n_out=128 (= 2*d_qk); v_lut: S=1, NAP=6, tph=512, n_out=64 (= d_v); out_proj: nh=1, NAP=6, tph=1024, n_out=384 (= E). All hybrid_smooth. No read_out, no joint qkv v-branch (these are the only differences vs exp611). Total ~270.5M (= exp611 289M - read_out 18.87M). Tests exp611's architecture minus the read_out contribution. Expected ~1.413 if read_out contributes -8 mb (per exp666 finding). References: exp611 = 1.4047 @ 289M (with read_out), exp666 = 1.4544 @ 92.8M (with read_out), exp670 = 1.4569 @ 86.5M.
